#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <queue>
#include <utility>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct Graph {
    int V;
    vector<int> head;
    vector<int> to;
    vector<int> next;
    vector<ll> cap;
    vector<ll> cost;
    vector<int> rev;
    int edgeCount;

    Graph(int V) : V(V), head(V, -1), edgeCount(0) {
        to.resize(2);
        next.resize(2);
        cap.resize(2);
        cost.resize(2);
        rev.resize(2);
    }

    void ensureCapacity(int size) {
        if (to.size() < size) {
            int newSize = max(size, 2 * (int)to.size());
            to.resize(newSize);
            next.resize(newSize);
            cap.resize(newSize);
            cost.resize(newSize);
            rev.resize(newSize);
        }
    }

    void addEdge(int from, int to, ll cost, ll cap, int rev) {
        ensureCapacity(edgeCount + 1);
        next[edgeCount] = head[from];
        head[from] = edgeCount;
        this->to[edgeCount] = to;
        this->cost[edgeCount] = cost;
        this->cap[edgeCount] = cap;
        this->rev[edgeCount] = rev;
        edgeCount++;
    }

    void addFlowWeightedEdge(int from, int to, ll cost, ll cap) {
        addEdge(from, to, cost, cap, edgeCount + 1);
        addEdge(to, from, -cost, 0, edgeCount - 1);
    }
};

struct MinCostFlow {
    Graph &g;
    int s, t;
    vector<ll> phi;
    vector<ll> dist;
    vector<int> prevv, preve;

    MinCostFlow(Graph &g, int s, int t, bool hasNegative) : g(g), s(s), t(t) {
        phi.assign(g.V, LLONG_MAX);
        if (hasNegative) {
            // SPFA (Bellman-Ford with queue)
            phi[s] = 0;
            vector<bool> inQueue(g.V, false);
            queue<int> q;
            q.push(s);
            inQueue[s] = true;
            int steps = 0;
            while (!q.empty()) {
                int v = q.front(); q.pop();
                inQueue[v] = false;
                for (int e = g.head[v]; e != -1; e = g.next[e]) {
                    if (g.cap[e] > 0) {
                        int u = g.to[e];
                        ll nd = phi[v] + g.cost[e];
                        if (phi[u] > nd) {
                            phi[u] = nd;
                            if (!inQueue[u]) {
                                q.push(u);
                                inQueue[u] = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                steps++;
                if (steps > 2 * g.V * g.V) {
                    // Negative cycle detected (should not happen)
                    // throw runtime_error("Negative cycle");
                }
            }
        }
        dist.resize(g.V);
        prevv.resize(g.V);
        preve.resize(g.V);
    }

    pair<ll, ll> minCostMaxFlow() {
        return minCostMaxFlow(LLONG_MAX);
    }

    pair<ll, ll> minCostMaxFlow(ll maxf) {
        ll flow = 0, cost = 0;
        while (flow < maxf) {
            fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), LLONG_MAX);
            dist[s] = 0;
            bool updated;
            for (int i = 0; i < g.V; i++) {
                updated = false;
                for (int v = 0; v < g.V; v++) {
                    if (dist[v] == LLONG_MAX) continue;
                    for (int e = g.head[v]; e != -1; e = g.next[e]) {
                        if (g.cap[e] > 0) {
                            int u = g.to[e];
                            ll nd = dist[v] + g.cost[e];
                            if (dist[u] > nd) {
                                dist[u] = nd;
                                prevv[u] = v;
                                preve[u] = e;
                                updated = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!updated) break;
            }
            if (dist[t] == LLONG_MAX) break;
            ll add = maxf - flow;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                add = min(add, g.cap[preve[v]]);
            }
            flow += add;
            cost += add * dist[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                int e = preve[v];
                g.cap[e] -= add;
                g.cap[g.rev[e]] += add;
            }
        }
        return make_pair(cost, flow);
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<int> cnt(26, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
        cnt[s[i] - 'a']++;
    }
    int pairCount = (n + 1) / 2;
    int V = n + 26 + 2;
    int source = V - 2;
    int sink = V - 1;
    Graph g(V);
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        g.addFlowWeightedEdge(source, i + n, 0, cnt[i]);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < pairCount; j++) {
            int left = j;
            int right = n - 1 - j;
            ll w = 0;
            if (s[left] == s[right]) {
                if (s[left] == (char)('a' + i)) {
                    w = -max(a[left], a[right]);
                }
            } else {
                if (s[left] == (char)('a' + i)) w -= a[left];
                if (s[right] == (char)('a' + i)) w -= a[right];
            }
            g.addFlowWeightedEdge(i + n, j, w, 1);
        }
    }
    for (int j = 0; j < pairCount; j++) {
        g.addFlowWeightedEdge(j, sink, 0, 2);
    }
    MinCostFlow mcmf(g, source, sink, true);
    pair<ll, ll> res = mcmf.minCostMaxFlow();
    cout << -res.first << endl;
    return 0;
}
